verses.text: Israel is a luxuriant vine; He produces fruit for himself. The more his fruit, The more altars he made; The richer his land, The better he made the [sacred] pillars.
verses.textZh: 以色列是茂盛的葡萄樹，結果繁多。果子越多，就越增添祭壇；地土越肥美，就越造美麗的柱像。

verses.text: Their heart is faithless; Now they must bear their guilt. The LORD will break down their altars [And] destroy their [sacred] pillars.
verses.textZh: 他們心懷二意，現今要定為有罪。耶和華必拆毀他們的祭壇，毀壞他們的柱像。

verses.text: Surely now they will say, 'We have no king, For we do not revere the LORD. As for the king, what can he do for us?'
verses.textZh: 他們必說：我們沒有王，因為我們不敬畏耶和華。王能為我們做甚麼呢？

verses.text: They speak [mere] words, With worthless oaths they make covenants; And judgment sprouts like poisonous weeds in the furrows of the field.
verses.textZh: 他們為立約說謊言，起假誓；因此，災罰如苦菜滋生在田間的犁溝中。

verses.text: The inhabitants of Samaria will fear For the calf of Beth-aven. Indeed, its people will mourn for it, And its idolatrous priests will cry out over it, Over its glory, since it has departed from it.
verses.textZh: 撒瑪利亞的居民必因伯亞文的牛犢驚恐；崇拜牛犢的民和喜愛牛犢的祭司都必因榮耀離開他，為他悲哀。

verses.text: The thing itself will be carried to Assyria As tribute to King Jareb; Ephraim will be seized with shame And Israel will be ashamed of its own counsel.
verses.textZh: 牛犢帶到亞述當作禮物，獻給耶雷布王。以法蓮必蒙羞；以色列必因自己的計謀慚愧。

verses.text: Samaria will be cut off [with] her king Like a stick on the surface of the water.
verses.textZh: 至於撒瑪利亞，他的王必滅沒，如水面的沫子一樣。

verses.text: Also the high places of Aven, the sin of Israel, will be destroyed; Thorn and thistle will grow on their altars; Then they will say to the mountains, 'Cover us!' And to the hills, 'Fall on us!'
verses.textZh: 伯亞文的邱壇─就是以色列取罪的地方必被毀滅；荊棘和蒺藜必長在他們的祭壇上。他們必對大山說：遮蓋我們！對小山說：倒在我們身上！

verses.text: From the days of Gibeah you have sinned, O Israel; There they stand! Will not the battle against the sons of iniquity overtake them in Gibeah?
verses.textZh: 以色列啊，你從基比亞的日子以來時常犯罪。你們的先人曾站在那裡，現今住基比亞的人以為攻擊罪孽之輩的戰事臨不到自己。

verses.text: When it is My desire, I will chastise them; And the peoples will be gathered against them When they are bound for their double guilt.
verses.textZh: 我必隨意懲罰他們。他們為兩樣的罪所纏；列邦的民必聚集攻擊他們。

verses.text: Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh, But I will come over her fair neck [with a yoke]; I will harness Ephraim, Judah will plow, Jacob will harrow for himself.
verses.textZh: 以法蓮是馴良的母牛犢，喜愛踹穀，我卻將軛加在他肥美的頸項上，我要使以法蓮拉套（或作：被騎）。猶大必耕田；雅各必耙地。

verses.text: Sow with a view to righteousness, Reap in accordance with kindness; Break up your fallow ground, For it is time to seek the LORD Until He comes to rain righteousness on you.
verses.textZh: 你們要為自己栽種公義，就能收割慈愛。現今正是尋求耶和華的時候；你們要開墾荒地，等他臨到，使公義如雨降在你們身上。

verses.text: You have plowed wickedness, you have reaped injustice, You have eaten the fruit of lies. Because you have trusted in your way, in your numerous warriors,
verses.textZh: 你們耕種的是奸惡，收割的是罪孽，吃的是謊話的果子。因你倚靠自己的行為，仰賴勇士眾多，

verses.text: Therefore a tumult will arise among your people, And all your fortresses will be destroyed, As Shalman destroyed Beth-arbel on the day of battle, [When] mothers were dashed in pieces with [their] children.
verses.textZh: 所以在這民中必有鬨嚷之聲，你一切的保障必被拆毀，就如沙勒幔在爭戰的日子拆毀伯亞比勒，將其中的母子一同摔死。

verses.text: Thus it will be done to you at Bethel because of your great wickedness. At dawn the king of Israel will be completely cut off.
verses.textZh: 因他們的大惡，伯特利必使你們遭遇如此。到了黎明，以色列的王必全然滅絕。
